mentions.name: Stock Portfolio & Watchlist
mentions.description: iOS app for tracking stock portfolios and watchlists, designed to group stocks by sector to make it easy to spot sector rotation; a UI update is planned. Data comes from the author's brokerage account, and the apps are free with optional donations.
mentions.problem: Wants to group stocks by sectors and see if there is sector rotation going on.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Stock Portfolio & Watchlist: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stock-portfolio-watchlist/id6760229592
The idea is I'd like to group stocks by sectors and see if there is sector rotation going on. I will have an UI update soon
